text: I love the concept, there's loads of recipes which i love making and I'm happy playing 1-3 times a day. problems are the forced prompts that lock you from doing anything else and are totally unnecessary! Also, too many gadgets, currently have several on the go, but ive 99+ items at the top ready to put on the board, as there is no room to put the rewards down to use them. strip it back! not 20 odd promotions going on all the time, never giving enough time to complete the extra activities please!

Don't spend money, once you spend you stop receiving the free ads. Like a lot of other players so at least not just me. The energy does get spent fast and you run out of spaces as you collect all the basic tools to make a higher level equipment. The dancing hand, as I call it, that keeps telling you what to do. Like I've reached level 66 I think I know what to do

Love the game but it's started glitching. Once on the game board, it freezes, sometimes straight away, mostly after a minute and then the screen goes blank. I'm having no problems with other games. Update on 24.11.24. Had a week of no issues then today the same issue has started again. There is no option to update the game. Can I uninstall and install without losing my level? Thanks

If you like watching ad videos this is the game for you... Absolutely terrible, I spend more time watching ads than I do playing the game. Shockingly shi*Update.. I was on level 52. However, since paying for a bundle deal I can no longer wait a while and have the option of watching a video to get free extra 25 moves or speed up a production.... This has only happened since I paid real money.... I deleted the app then reinstalled it from level 0 and it did the same. Only on my phone. Scam!!!

Nice relaxing game that you don't have to pay to enjoy, ads are optional for bonus extras. My only issue is anytime an event comes around (cycled through the same things pretty regularly) you are forced every time to be shown what to do, there's an option to look at how to play that pops up, I think it should be left at that, especially with how many things pop up as you are playing anyway. Just frustrating sometimes when I already know what to do but forced to go through it again and again.

Too greedy! I used to be able to play for much longer by watching ads, but after the recent update, most freebies via watching ads disappeared, and it is now impossible to play some of the bonus games without spending money. I used to spend about £10 a week, but with this greedy game, I'll let my money go to other games that make me happy instead of frustrated!

This is adverts with a few minutes of merge game in between. The game has a lot of potential, which is why I just about reached 2 stars. It has different features, like the generators, can produce merges, that themselves are short term generators. You can also mix or cook merges. Like put an apple and pear in the mixer. Play for about 10 minutes, all generators are on cool down. For a very long time. I reduced the time by 15 minutes, yet all generators still off. Leaving nothing to merge. Bye

I'm really enjoying this game, it's super fun and enjoyable, but the one thing that's putting me off a little is how long we have to wait for generators to regenerate. I'll be finished using 1 generator that I really need in like 2 minutes and have to wait several hours for a recharge. Having to wait that long isn't great. Otherwise I am having fun

BEWARE, They removed all optional adds content, no free energy and items just for watching an add anymore! You want the daily content? You need to pay for it! I have been playing this game for a long time, it was my favourite merge game, but this morning they killed it. Developers, please reverse your changes, those optional adds were great feature, there isn't enough energy to play without them. EDIT: the adds are back! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

This is probably my favourite merge game I've found. However, I have a few issues with it. The bubbles that come on the board offering you to pay diamonds to get a double of the item - you can't pop them or quickly sell them, you have to wait for them to time out and sometimes I have like seven of them on my board taking up space. Another is that as you progress, you can only really play for 30 seconds at a time without your energy depleting to nothing :(

UPDATE: Great!! Most of the free ad options are gone after the newest update! The amount of time i spent in the game significantly reduced which is good maybe lol I was feeling guilty to spend so much time in the game anyways. OLD COMMENT: I want to change my stars to 5 because the game is more enjoyable with last updates. Before, it was almost impossible to play more than 5 minutes because energy was going real fast. but with the new ad options I can play for hours lol. This game is addictive!

I like the premise of the game & the graphics (unlike other merge games I'm actually excited to merge to unlock new recipes), but the main limit is the amount of energy- this always runs out quickly & there are no ad options or mini-games to help gain more energy, so I just have to wait. I am building up cooking boosts and generator boosts but can't use them because the main limiter is energy. while I'm glad there are no pop up ads I would gladly opt in to watching an ad to gain more energy

The game itself is good and there is a constant flow of was new things to create and discover but every time anything happens like running out of energy or a generator needs to recharge, three or four offers pop up on the screen. This is getting frustrating as it interupts gameplay greatly and makes it difficult to go more than five minutes without the inconvenience of closing a load of pop ups.

can hardly play any more because all the ads have vanished so I can't get bonus lives / bubble items unless I spend a load of money (which I'm not going to, not remotely worth it). other people have said this and the response given is that the ads are based on algorithms that consider device type but I've been playing on the same phone for 2 years so that doesn't really make sense. shame because I really like the game but this update has really ruined it for me

Nice and fun at first but as you go forward you get frustrated. I don't spend money and don't mind as however I'm at level 16 and no space on the board, it's hard to create the items and the chest takes hours and hours to refill...means I can play 5min a couple of times a day. So I'll delete it as can't keep going

I have only been playing for a couple of days and have to say this is the best game out of every merge game I have played. I gave it 4* because energy runs out too quickly. Solve that and you will get 5* I don't normally like ads but I watch to get 25 energy. I don't pay to play so I won't be paying to play. Remove the pop ups please trying to encourage us to purchase items it's getting ridiculously needy. You won't be getting money out of me, so the pop ups are pointless 😏 overall good game

This is actually my fave merge game that I have tried, and I have tried many. Why I gave this a high rating is because there are no annoying ads popping up randomly, you choose to watch them by refreshing the generator or speeding up cooking. A lot of the actions have option to watch and to speed things up. You can even keep watching ads to get more energy. Lots of items in game to keep interesting, putting items into a appliance to cook is unique and interesting.

Great game initially. One of the few problems is it stops playing any background music or noise. Also once you have maxed out the size of the grid it's too small. You get to the point where only generators are covering the board, and there is no space for merging. I don't really know why the grid cannot be the same size as in the ad which initially made me install this game. After you have passed the first 15 levels you stop getting a space in the inventory as a prize. Which is needed.

I only started playing this game about 2weeks ago but I ABSOLUTELY love it & literally cannot stop playing it, great graphics, fun gameplay, never crashes like other games. *UPDATED* Yes it turned out I needed all 8 scissor pieces at 1000 medal rewards each...then after ONE use only they're gone which is an absolute rip off so you'll buy more 🙄! Still play the game but not as impressed anymore at all!!

It's good but very annoying. An addictive game like all merge games, but so frustrating I give up most days. Some of the merges take over 300 energy to produce one item which is ridiculous. The higher the merge the more annoying it is, unless you want to spend £100 buying diamonds for energy. Some of the generators give absolutely b* all. If you use a speed up it only gives a few clicks before it runs out again which is abit cheeky. It takes hours to regen 100 energy points. Good but not!

Very catchy game, good plot, good action level. But one can't play for more than 2 minutes without having to watch ads. They are always the same ads (5 or 6). Time consuming, it becomes annoying and boring and frustrating. I will submit this review and uninstall.

I loved this game when I first started playing, but now, whenever I try to play it, it just freezes and crashes, and it's started to get annoying. I just wanna play without it sending me back to the home screen every 5 seconds, I've gotten to level 60, and I don't want to have to delete it and lose all my progress, but if it keeps not working, I might delete it for good.

it's an okay game. it's actually incredibly fun to play and really enjoyable, until you have no energy. you have to wait about two minutes for one energy, which is equivalent to one item. to buy energy you have to pay lots for, and it really isn't worth it in the end. there are luckily no ads but there are so many pop ups trying to make you buy things.

Just be aware the ads cheat 3 out of 5 times. It will get to the end of the countdown timer and will automatically open a browser to download the app and when you go back to the game it will now restart so you've watched an ad for nothing because you now didn't get the reward you watched the ad for. So a heads up don't bother....

This game is amazing compared to others of same gameplay. My only issue with this game is that the "main" story feels very empty and boring. It's repetitive, it doesnt have a plot that makes us see the next step so it's very easy to put the game aside to try new things. If this game had a real storyline it would be 150/100! Congrats!

I would enjoy this if it wasn't for the constant prompts. It dictates how you move through the game, which I hate. I had to uninstall this after 20 minutes as the hand and dictation was so irritating - I wish they would get rid of it. Constantly pointing at what to do/which move to make. It would be nice if the hand was removed to allow the player to play the game.

I find this game to be a lot of fun, and a great way to pass some time. It's fun finding out which generators produce certain goods and finding out which goods go together to make more complex products. Sound interesting? You'll have to play it to find out more. You won't be disappointed. The only thing I think is missing, is a bit of a storyline as you move through the other half of the game. The character upgrades food outlets, but there's no real incentive to be invested in the process.

I like the game, but I feel the board is too small. For a 7x9 game board, the number of things that you have to merge is too small. I play it about 3 times a day. No ads are interrupting the game, which is great. There are ads with the chests and things, which I think is a good balance. I'm in between 3 and a 4 out of 10, but went for the 4 as I'd say it's a high 3. A bigger board would definitely keep me playing for longer

The clever thing about this game is no ads interrupting, the chests contain ads, special bonuses if you watch a short ad, need more time from your spawning item, watch an ad. Wish I can give it another chance but seems hopeless.
